mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_tool_deployment_create_receipts(tenant_id,request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(#{tenant},CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_tool_deployment_create_receipts SET outcome='REJECTED',deployment_key=#{deploymentKey} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND outcome='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,outcome,deployment_id,deployment_key FROM nw_tool_deployment_create_receipts WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
